[SWS_DM_01974] Indicator reporting kOnDemand
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
If at least one indicator state of an event assigned to a DTC is in state kOnDemand,
the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall return kOnDemand as return value of
ara::diag::Indicator::GetIndicatorState
⌋
